source.name: Gambling News: Birmingham City Welcomes Entain's Coral as Front-of-Shirt Sponsor in 2026/27
source.quote: Starting from the upcoming season, however, the brand will also have its logo displayed on men’s and women’s shirts.
source.note: The article reports Coral's first front-of-shirt partnership, with the logo on the men's and women's shirts from 2026/27.

summary: Entain's Coral betting brand sits on the front of the Birmingham City Women shirt from 2026/27, the brand's first front-of-shirt deal (Gambling News). sponsorsComplete is false: the cited coverage names only the front sponsor and says nothing about sleeves, back or shorts; the club store product pages cited informally for that are not reachable to verify.
